 Jeremy Saulnier’s SLAYGROUND Gets A Metal AF New Teaser
 Amber T Updated Tue, October 20, 2026 at 1:10 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Green Room director Jeremy Saulnier makes a long-awaited return to genre with Slayground , with A24 today releasing the first full trailer for the Halloween-set fugitive thriller. Brace yourself:
 Starring Imogen Poots ( Green Room ), James Badge Dale ( The Empty Man) , Matty Matheson ( The Bear ), Cory Michael Smith ( Saturday Night ), Chase Sui Wonders ( I Know What You Did Last Summer ), Sophie Wilde ( Talk to Me ), and Young Mazino ( The Last of Us ), Slayground officially hits theaters on January 29, 2027.
 Previously titled October , in Slayground , scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers with no memory of how they got there. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth – even if the trail leads straight back to him.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Slayground is produced by A24, Rich Peete ( Neighborhood Watch ), Eli Bush ( Central ) and Saulnier and Skei Saulnier ( Niteowl Films ), with Ronald Bronstein and Josh Safdie ( Central ), Traci Carlson and Elliott Coley ( Neighborhood Watch ) and The Toxic Avenger 's Macon Blair ( Bonneville Pictures ) exec producing.
 Nine Inch Nails maestros Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross provide new music for the film.
 Slayground releases in theaters on January 29, 2027. Check out a new poster below, and for more 2027 horror movies, here's our list of everything with a confirmed release date to come next year.
